newsitem.title: USA: AMR ready to give EU BA alliance data.
newsitem.headline: AMR ready to give EU BA alliance data.

text.p: American Airlines, a unit of AMR Corp, said on Tuesday it would provide any information needed by the European Commission to back its proposed alliance with British Airways Plc.

But American spokesman Chris Chiames said AMR remained puzzled by the commission's high interest in the BA alliance, while it showed no similar interest in the many previous linkups between other U.S. carriers and European airlines.
Chiames was responding to remarks earlier by European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert in Brussels, who said that the European Union would not close its eyes to the alliance.

Van Miert noted that the alliance would control 61 percent of the passenger traffic between the United States and Britain. He added that the European Parliament needed more information on the alliance to meet its objections, but he did not detail the additional information required.
"We've been cooperating with them and will provide them any information they need," Chiames said.
"We're puzzled they are holding this alliance to a different standard than the other alliances," he added.
